objective: Compare speed and heads-up strength of existing low-latency poker policies and explicitly marked sampling-budget variants.

modifications.cfr_lite64: Original rules and action sizing, 64 Monte Carlo rollouts each postflop street instead of original configured counts. Changes stochastic approximation, not a strategy-equivalence claim.
modifications.hydra32: Original adaptive_hydra, max_iters=32 instead of 300 in _mc_equity; no other strategic changes.
modifications.fullhouse: Previously validated FP32 ONNX export, original released weights.

latency: Single CPU core 2; full decision function; 10000 legal HU states balanced by street, 3 repetitions; GC disabled; p99 threshold only, tail exceedances reported.

arena.score: 100*ending chip share; exact HU ICM for payouts [100,0]
arena.sampling: Same decks, swapped seats; pair as independent unit; common seed indexes across all matchups.
arena.precision: Report 95% CIs; two prespecified primary comparisons also report Bonferroni 97.5% CIs.

validation: 6 games exactly match legacy harness scores and hand counts; 5 mirror pairs score exactly 50. Existing engine passed 2000 PokerKit differential hands.
